# Commands manual worktrees and one-time Codex history transfer

The kit is a point-in-time migration, not a synchronizer: `/export` Markdown and the official Import-to-ChatGPT flow do not restore bulk Codex history. Keep code, branches, credentials, remote pairings, worktrees, and unrelated projects out; clone Commands/comm separately. [Task 2]

Scope: console.
